prerequisites: To enroll in specific technology subjects (third year), students must have passed at least 60 ECTS credits from the basic training module subjects and the common subjects module for the industrial branch (first and second year).

For a correct understanding of the subject, it is convenient to have approved and clearly understood the concepts explained in the subjects of Calculus (1st year), Physics (1st year), Chemistry (1st year) and Thermal Engineering (2nd year).

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the knowledge acquired in subjects from previous courses to power systems, air treatment systems, and engine and refrigeration systems through practical exercises that provide great versatility to adapt to new situations.
Communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Mechanical Engineering.
Fluently handle various forms of representation such as graphs, tables, diagrams or formulations, both to extract information and to use them when expressing results.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.

Apply the strategies of the scientific methodology: analyze the problematic situation qualitatively and quantitatively, propose hypotheses and solutions using the models typical of industrial engineering, mechanical specialty.

Employ applied thermal engineering and thermodynamics knowledge to applied thermal power and refrigeration systems through practical exercises that provide great versatility to adapt to new situations.
Communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of thermal engineering.
Work in a team to undertake cooperative tasks with peers in the field of experimentation in thermal engineering, making proposals, discussing ideas and executing relevant actions.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations and mandatory standards in the area of thermal installations and machines.

teaching_methods: Computer practices (P. Ordenador) using EES software
Consultation of basic and recommended bibliography

assessment_methods.method: Completion of practicals (exercises, cases or problems)

assessment_rules: The final grade is 80% from the written test and 20% from computer practicals. To pass, a minimum of 50% must be obtained in the written test. If the written test is failed but practicals are passed, the practicals grade is saved for the extraordinary call. Not attending the official exam implies renunciation.
